node.statement: For fixed u satisfying 0<=u.d_i<=1, the largest feasible t in the displayed LP is min_{f in F_v} u.d_f. Hence maximizing t is exactly the exposedness-margin supremum t*(v). The point u=0,t=0 is feasible, and if F_v is nonempty then t<=u.d_f<=1 for any f in F_v, so the primal objective is bounded above by 1.
